svg.title: Product search and shopping list creation

g.text: Product search and shopping list creation
Search from the new list page
fetchProducts catches error and sets productsError
“Could not load products. Please try again.”
Runs text search and returns ordered IDs
Loads validated products, relations, and page
Displays products and prices for selection
Selects products and enters a list name
Keeps selections locally; validates name and items
ListStoreRequest validates name, items, and existing IDs
saveList catches error; does not navigate to /
Current code logs the error to the console;
this page does not show a dedicated error message.
Returns to the home page after saving
Meilisearch is an optional search index; failures fall back to MySQL.
The list and its relations are written to MySQL in a transaction.
